scope: Clarifies only the delivery condition for v1 mandatory explanations a and b; does not change any source, running English, note wording, confidence, author verdict, adverse peer verdict or publication status.
rationale: My phrase mandatory_visible_notes_before_publication meant that the exact complete explanations must be genuinely delivered to a reader, not silently dropped.
